metadata.title: TechToJob — Community for Developers and Tech Companies
metadata.description: A community where developers and tech companies connect by building, sharing and participating.

hero.title: More than a job board.
hero.titleAccent: A community where you can be seen.
hero.description: TechToJob is a community for developers and tech companies in Spanish. Build real projects, join tournaments and connect with people before a job opening even exists.
hero.codeNote: Built and reviewed by the community
hero.messageNote: Saw your work in the challenge
hero.message: I liked how you solved the problem. Want to talk?
hero.caption: Get known by what you build

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.description: Join the community, participate and show how you work. Opportunities come from being involved, not from filling out endless forms.

steps.title: Join Discord
steps.description: Introduce yourself, find your stack channels and see what the community is building.

steps.title: Build and participate
steps.description: Join tournaments, help other developers and share what you are working on.

steps.title: Show how you work
steps.description: Your projects, code and ideas give people a better idea of how you solve problems.

steps.title: Connect with people
steps.description: Companies and developers can discover your work and start a conversation directly.

talent.title: Show what you can do, not just what is on your CV
talent.description: Create a profile with your stack, experience and availability. You can also show the projects and challenges that represent your work.
points: You do not need to be senior

profile.name: Javier Santos
profile.projectNote: Built a dashboard with real-time data and incremental loading.

companies.title: See how people work before hiring
companies.description: A CV tells you what someone says they know. Projects, challenges and technical discussions give you more context about how they actually work.
companies.traditionalText: Go through hundreds of CVs, compare the same lists of technologies and interview candidates before knowing how they solve real problems.
companies.approachText: Explore developer profiles, see their projects and follow their participation in the community before starting a conversation.
companies.benefitDescription: Get to know the person behind the CV before making a hiring decision.

tournaments.title: Build something. Show what you know.
tournaments.description: Take part in technical challenges, build real projects and have something concrete to show in your portfolio and interviews.
tournaments.featureDescription: Every tournament gives you a chance to learn, build and make your work visible to the community.

networking.title: Some opportunities never become job posts
networking.description: People often hear about good opportunities through someone they know. That happens here too.
networking.cardNote: Stay involved and you are more likely to hear what is happening inside the community.

news.title: What is happening in the community

items.title: The community web design challenge
items.summary: Developers put their frontend and design skills to the test in a community challenge.

items.title: Technical talks from the community
items.summary: Developers share practical knowledge about architecture, development and real-world projects.

items.title: New public talent profiles
items.summary: A new way for developers to share their skills, projects and availability.

newsletter.title: Get community news and opportunities
newsletter.description: Get updates about tournaments, opportunities, technical content and what is happening in the community.
newsletter.success: Done! You are on the list.
newsletter.privacy: One email when there is something worth sharing. No spam.

closing.title: Your next opportunity might start with a conversation.
closing.description: Join the community, build something and let people see what you can do.

footer.description: A community where developers and tech companies connect by building.
footer.legalNote: TechToJob does not guarantee employment. Opportunities depend on community participation and company needs.
